💾 Save & Send to Mollie

⬆️ Push to GitHub

How the push works: 1. Tap "Download Push Package" - saves this editor with ALL your edits baked in 2. Send the downloaded file to Mollie in chat (or tap "Copy JSON" and paste it) 3. Mollie pushes it to kingmarkarnold-code/adamsville-map-editor on GitHub 4. No GitHub login needed on your end - Mollie handles the push.

📋 Send Protocol

When you send changes: 1. Your zones, roads, labels, and edits are packaged into a JSON file 2. The file is prepared for Mollie to receive 3. Mollie will apply your changes directly to the GitHub repository (kingmarkarnold-code/adamsville-play) 4. Changes go live after GitHub Pages rebuilds (~10 min) What gets applied: - ✅ New/modified zone boundaries → zoneloader.js ZONE_BOUNDS - ✅ Added roads → roads.js (correct category) - ✅ Deleted roads/segments → removed from roads.js - ✅ Renamed roads → updated names in roads.js - ✅ Merged roads → endpoint snapped to the target road's edge (T-junction) - ✅ Extended roads → stretched to the new endpoint - ✅ Joined roads → combined into one road object - ✅ On-ramps → new ramp road objects climbing to overpass/bridge decks - ✅ Bridges/overpasses → per-segment elevation markers with deck heights - ✅ Confirmed crossings → at-grade or overpass decisions applied - ✅ Custom labels → added as map annotations You don't need to do anything after sending — Mollie handles the GitHub update.
